text:
marta: Heads up — Acme just confirmed a hard commit for Q3, need to move 8xA100 reserved slots from pool-gpu-temp -> pool-gpu-acme. Currently #7890 is at position 6 in the wait queue. Can someone escalate or propose a swap?
reservation-bot: Reservation request 7890 created by marta. Status: waiting (pos:6). ETA based on current lead times: ~7d. /help for ops docs.
kevin: Can you paste the reservation IDs + target pool? I can check if any idle capacity in other zones.
marta: IDs: src=res-55321(pool-gpu-temp), dst=pool-gpu-acme. Command I ran: `rwctl reservations show res-55321` -> shows allocated: 0, requested: 8, earliest-fulfill: 2026-03-29.
julia: we have a billing hold on Acme's account (invoice INV-9921) which is blocking new reserved bindings. Billing pinged earlier today. @billing any update?
billing: Looking now — INV-9921 is flagged for mismatch, finance is reviewing. We can clear hold with payment confirmation or create a temporary exception for infra-approved customer commits. Which do you prefer?
sam: Short-term workaround: we can provision burst capacity from eu-west GPU pool and VPN route to their VPC, then create a short-lived reservation transfer. Network team: are cross-region tunnels okay for the data path? latency might rise but acceptable for sync jobs.
kevin: Cost note: moving 8 A100s to dedicated reserved will add ~+$12.8k/mo vs spot. If we do cross-region burst it'll be ~$18k/mo plus egress. If billing can flip hold -> exception for 72h, that's cheapest.
marta: Okay option order: 1) billing exception 72h, do direct reservation swap; 2) temporary cross-region burst; 3) escalate procurement for full payment. Anyone can approve a 72h exception?
julia: I can approve a 72h exception for Acme provided we log it and set auto-revoke. Approving now. :white_check_mark:
billing: Exception created: EXC-4412, expires 72h. Clearing internal hold now.
kevin: I kicked a reservation-priority-swap job: `rwctl reservations swap --src res-55321 --dst pool-gpu-acme --count 8 --priority high --ticket EXC-4412` — job id swap-9982.
reservation-bot: swap-9982 started, checking target pool capacity...
reservation-bot: swap-9982 step1: drained idle in pool-gpu-temp (6/8 available). step2: queued remote allocations (2/8) via cross-pool borrow.
reservation-bot: swap-9982 completed. New reservation res-55321 -> res-55321a bound to pool-gpu-acme. Change log: swapped 8 GPUs at 2026-03-20T15:12Z.
marta: Verified on our end, Acme confirmed region tests passing. Thanks all.
sam: Noted: create follow-up to evaluate cost impact & decide if commit should be upgraded to annual to save $ vs monthly reserved. I'll add to next-week ops retro.
julia: Logged audit: incident-ticket INC-3310 created for swap + billing exception EXC-4412.
billing: Invoice update: Acme payment cleared 2026-03-21 09:04Z. We'll remove the exception early and convert reservation to standard billing.
marta: Closing — thread resolved. :tada:
